title: Jesus Shines Like the Sun
reflectionQuestion: The friends saw Jesus shining bright as the sun, and they were filled with wonder. I wonder what fills your heart with wonder when you think about God?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Miracles). Batch D 'replayability/wonder' piece. Adam's rule: AWE not scary. The bright cloud + the voice are wonder-filled and KIND ('This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him.') -- explicitly 'not a scary voice... warm, and kind, and full of love'. Moses & Elijah kept simple ('two of God's great friends from long, long ago') -- no theology load for 4-7. Peter's 'let's build tents!' is the comic/relatable beat. Ends with the cloud lifting, Jesus back to normal ('their own dear friend'), 'Do not be afraid', walking back down -- safe landing. Soft close ('shine'/'sun'). VOICE_JAMES_BRITISH_PROFESSIONAL (stately, cinematic awe register).
